title.value: Implicit Regularization or Implicit Conditioning? Exact Risk Trajectories of SGD in High Dimensions
title.justification: The title reflects the main theme of the paper, which is analyzing the behavior of SGD (Stochastic Gradient Descent) in high dimensions, focusing on concepts like implicit regularization and conditioning.
title.quote: Implicit Regularization or Implicit Conditioning? Exact Risk Trajectories of SGD in High Dimensions

extractions.description: The paper investigates the dynamics and efficiency of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) in high-dimensional convex quadratic settings. It establishes an asymptotic equivalence between SGD and a stochastic differential equation called homogenized stochastic gradient descent (HSGD). The authors derive exact formulas for learning and risk trajectories, revealing mechanisms that explain the efficiency of SGD compared to full-batch gradient descent (GD). The study finds that while SGD does not enhance generalization performance due to noise, it often accelerates convergence through implicit conditioning, depending on data characteristics.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on the theoretical examination of SGD mechanisms without directly addressing any climate or ecological sustainable development goals. The discussion centers on machine learning and optimization rather than sustainability applications.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Finally, we show how to adapt the HSGD formalism to include streaming SGD, which allows us to produce an exact prediction for the excess risk of multi-pass SGD relative to that of streaming SGD (bootstrap risk).

primary_category.justification: The paper does not primarily focus on any specific climate or ecological sustainable development category. It is mainly concerned with the optimization techniques in machine learning.
primary_category.quote: The efficiency of SGD has been the subject of extensive research, dating back to the original work of Robbins and Monro [43] and extending to modern large-scale machine learning applications (see e.g. [8, 10]). However, despite its widespread adoption and algorithmic simplicity, surprisingly little is known about how SGD performs in the types of high-dimensional optimization problems that occur in practice.

secondary_categories.quote: In this work, we study the dynamics of multi-pass SGD on high-dimensional convex quadratics and derive exact asymptotic predictions for the learning and risk trajectories.
